optimizer.role: numeric and effective talent-level authority; Swift charged formula resolves to autoIndex

gcsim.role: conditional action admission, timing, snapshot, target and A1 callback behavior; its conflicting Swift skill-level binding is not used

genshin-db.role: catalog vector and Chinese talent-label corroboration
genshin-db.verification: original bytes read using git show fixed-revision:path and matched rev-parse blob identities

archive.format: gzip JSON; files contain original UTF-8 strings keyed by source alias and original path; selectedTreeEvidence is separate metadata

bindingChain.meaning: a starts at -1; swiftDmg is the fifth auto vector, auto[4]
dmgNode charged with electro override only; no sixth overrideTalentType argument
charged maps to talent type auto
premod.auto is char.talent.auto; skill is a separate field

preservedBindingConflict.kind: talent selector conflict, not coefficient-vector mismatch
preservedBindingConflict.resolution: Use independently pinned Optimizer autoIndex binding and exact catalog combat1.param5; preserve original gcsim source unchanged. Do not require NA==E to hide the conflict.

timingEvidence.frameOrder: Simulation tick and character tasks occur before a new action starts; at hit frame Core.QueueAttack first makes the offensive snapshot, immediately applies attack, and the enemy damage task later invokes A1 callback.
timingEvidence.shape: NewCircleHitOnTargetFanAngle(primary target, offset Y=0.5, radius 2.5, 360 degrees); target contact remains explicit, not automatic.

admissionEvidence.normalInput: Requires actual fast-skill at action execution; Attack forwards to ChargeAttack. No charged-action stamina deduction in the ActionAttack executor.
admissionEvidence.chargedInput: Requires actual fast-skill or Nightsoul HasBlessing; fast-skill alone bypasses the ordinary polearm prior-normal queue requirement. Nightsoul alone does not bypass it.
admissionEvidence.stamina: fast-skill charge costs 0; otherwise default polearm charge costs 25, with actual stamina availability and multiplier=1 required for this branch. Stamina check and debit precede ChargeAttack deleting fast-skill.
admissionEvidence.actualState: Use execution-time observed state after that frame character ticks and expiry callbacks; an expiry timestamp alone cannot prove the state still exists.

passiveEvidence.a1PriorBuff: If already active at the 25-frame snapshot, actual ATK% and the share already included must be accounted for once. Do not infer active A1 from action-start state.
passiveEvidence.a1NewGrant: Ascension>=1, one eligible enemy callback per Swift attack grants/refreshes 20% ATK (fraction 0.2) with source modifier duration 900 frames, after this attack snapshot/damage. No enemy contact means no new A1 grant; a miss on the selected target does not establish whether other enemies were contacted or A1 was granted. This record does not simulate future attacks or require future modifier-expiry observation.
passiveEvidence.priorBurst: This restricted branch requires Iansan Q inactive at the 25-frame snapshot. Active Q feedback or existing Q ATK bonuses at that snapshot are outside scope; prior Q, Nightsoul points, movement and recipients are not reconstructed.
passiveEvidence.otherPassives: A4 healing and resource changes are not additional direct damage; C1-C6 excluded.

scope.completeActionMeaning: The only direct-damage candidate of one admitted Swift action, including an explicitly observed miss; not E+Swift and not a complete Nightsoul state.
exclusions: complete Nightsoul state or automatic resource history
automatic target contact or aura/ICD simulation
